name: CoordinatorFromHome

execution.description: Initial navigation/execution details are not available because no screen ids or targets were supplied in the context.

screens.description: home screen definition/id is not available in context
coordinator screen definition/id is not available in context

assumptions: Screen ids and execution start details are not present in the context, so they are represented as unresolved rather than invented.
The request's 'home' is used as a local starting-screen label and 'coordinator' as the next-screen label.
Both 'Coordinator' checks are interpreted as visible-text assertions using an explicit text target.
The tap on visible text 'Coordinator' is assumed to navigate to the next local visit.
